query: SELECT h.task_type,COUNT(*) AS matches,SUM(CASE WHEN h.timestamp BETWEEN a.start AND a.end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS task_stamp_inside_launch_api,SUM(CASE WHEN h.timestamp>a.end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stamp_after_api FROM HostTask h JOIN api.ApiData a ON h.connection_id=a.connection_id WHERE h.stream_id=466 AND a.struct_type='launch' GROUP BY h.task_type ORDER BY matches DESC LIMIT 20
limits: Raw timestamps are compared in their own CPU counter domain, not guessed as nanoseconds.
